description: Wyoming motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Wyoming rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Wyoming age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Wyoming?

provenance.manual: Motorcycle Safety Laws - Wyoming Department of Transportation

questions.q: What does Wyoming law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Wyoming: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: Motorcycle Safety Laws - Wyoming Department of Transportation

questions.q: In Wyoming, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Wyoming issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
